sentences.en: All the accepted notions and prejudices about flesh being pink.
sentences.zh: 关于肉色是粉红色的所有公认观念和偏见。

sentences.en: She really cut a dash in her pink evening gown.
sentences.zh: 她穿着粉红色晚礼服真是光彩照人。

sentences.en: Please do not think of a pink elephant right now.
sentences.zh: 请现在别想粉红色的大象。
